source_excerpt: We continue to expect 2026 cash capital expenditures to be approximately $220 billion.
In 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment and data centers.
We will continue to invest in capital expenditures to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI training and other infrastructure.
We anticipate making capital expenditures of approximately $135 billion to $145 billion in 2026 to support our AI efforts and core business.
